_comment: Copy to config.json and fill in. Every key is optional: anything absent falls back to the defaults in vodpipe/config.py. You can also set secrets in the app instead of here, or via the DEEPGRAM_API_KEY / TWITCH_OAUTH_TOKEN environment variables. network.proxy is an optional HTTP/SOCKS proxy (e.g. socks5://127.0.0.1:1080) used for live capture, VOD download, live-status probes and chat -- set it to reach Twitch and record source quality from a region it has left, such as South Korea, without a full VPN. The report engine is summary.provider: claude-cli | grok-cli | none. Both spend a local subscription CLI (Claude Code or Grok) and need no key; leave summary.model blank so Claude Code picks, or so Grok uses its CLI default (currently Grok 4.6). chat.enabled downloads Twitch chat for live (IRC) and VODs (GraphQL).
